identification: Six modern pressed vaseline (uranium) glass pieces: four miniature covered novelty dishes (hen, turkey, cat, dog on lace-edge bases) in the Boyd/Degenhart/Mosser style, plus two vaseline eye baths (one Guernsey-style with opalescent rim). No marks seen. Modern reproduction, not antique.
